phoneSketches

Website, Mobile, Interactive2023-2024

Public and Private within JavaScript and forbidden taboo Facebook groups. These two p5js sketches explore public and private spaces with inverting the way it's being interacted with. One has the user put two fingers on the phone to show a private message shared in homoerotic Facebook groups, the other one functions as a scratch lottery to reveal love messages from a scam website gathered from a graffiti in Baku streets.
